# cgltf provenance

Vestigio vendors the single-header cgltf 1.15 parser from the repository's
pinned raylib 5.5 source archive. The vendored file is byte-for-byte identical
to `src/external/cgltf.h` in raylib commit
`dbc56a87da87d973a9c5baa4e7438a9d20121d28`.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf>
- License: MIT (the complete notice is retained in `cgltf.h`)
- SHA-256: `efb169dee911696b5d35fc8e3f7ea0c56d679debc529eba9ca6aa6443ba9d5e9`
- Pinned raylib archive SHA-256:
  `81b06ce7c19cf3b634b0271c23c361ba6ad8bf45fb8b036abbfeb4260ec1e126`

No network fetch is required by the build.
